preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'B', 'R'} for _, _, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must have a color that is either 'B' (blue) or 'R' (red).

postconditions.description: If it's impossible to make all edges equal, output -1; otherwise, output the number of moves k and the corresponding vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n for a in moves)
postconditions.description: All vertices in the output sequence must be valid indices within the range of 1 to n.
The number of moves output must match the specified number of moves k.
